title: TREE_HEAL_LATE_SAFE

step1.method: Passive /tmp logger (per-decision mode, HP, zone, threats with distance / closing speed from vel / seen) on P48 b9492c6 and P49b 0c6b134, single-seed trees-on runs SEED_BASE=<seed>; CSV rows reproduce /workspace/tester/runs trees-b9492c6-5000 and trees-0c6b134-5000 exactly.

step1.common_cause: 3 of 5 (5053, 5032, 5024): the tree heal started while EVERY enemy that saw us was beyond near range (83-199 m) and walking straight at us (11.4-11.7 m/s, walk speed). Hiding from a hunter that is still coming is short-lived; the walk gave up the champion's standing fire / engage start and changed where the fight happened. 5055 and 5037 (enemy stopped at ~45 m) do not share it.
step1.caveat: Same start condition also holds on 3 of 8 P49b gain/held seeds checked (4043 4->1, 2090 4->3, 5091 1->1); 2022, 2055, 4027, 5017, 5003 gains do not match it. 4043 showed one nondeterministic logger run (7th) vs 1st on rerun and in the official CSV.

hypothesis: P49b's tree heal regresses when it starts (or keeps walking) while every enemy that sees us is still far and closing on us; skipping the tree heal in exactly that case recovers those games and keeps P49b's survivor gain (F4).
mechanism: Inside P49b's treeHeal() only (TREE_HEAL_ON): when every seer (enemy that sees us, the heal's own cone test) is beyond cfg.vision.near_range (45 m) and closing on us at >= TREE_HEAL_CLOSE_MPS (6 m/s, about half walk speed, from its obs vel), do not start a tree-heal walk (champion standing heal instead), and end an attempt in progress (same bookkeeping as P49b's cap: spot skip-listed, attempt spent for this heal phase). Everything else is P49b.
strength_kept: P49b survivor gain (2->4 and 3->5 official, 2->4 and 3->6 Mac) and no heal-hold pins (2022, 3066, 3086 cleared).
weakness_fixed: Tree heal walking away from a hunter that is still far and closing (5053, 5032, 5024 regressions).
differs_from_P49b: One extra stop condition inside the same tree heal; the walk, spot search, 8 s cap and zone/drop exits are unchanged.
success: Majority (3+) of 5055/5053/5032/5037/5024 recover vs P49b, no new pins or vetoes on bases 0 and 6000, survivors kept vs P48.
disproof: If the fix leaves 3+ of the 5 seeds regressed vs P48, or practice shows deaths <40 s or new >=20 s pins on either base, or the survivors gain vs P48 vanishes on both bases, stop and report, no PR.
drop_gate: Unchanged from P49b (healDropReach: drop near AND reachable within DROP_RUN_M, never in a drop run/hold). The new condition only removes tree-heal ticks.
source: Coordinator brief 1:09 AM ET Sun Nov 22; PR #177 Mac screen (5000-seed regressions) and Sim Tester screen
